opening.argument: The video describes a conventional business service: Infusion combines technology and design to transform RBC branches, and can serve as an end-to-end partner for banks pursuing that work. Its examples are branch interactions, including touchscreens offering tools, advice tips, product information and promotions. Possible savings arise in that context, not as a guaranteed-return offer or a stated payment condition. The material describes commercial services and branch experiences; it does not describe deceptive solicitation or require a transfer of money or data.

citations.quote: Infusion combines technology and beautiful design to transform RBC Royal Bank branches into retail stores of the future.
Infusion can be an end to end, one stop shop for any bank that wants to do their branch transformation strategy.

The content on the touch screens leverage a variety of things like gamification ideas, direct access to tools and calculators, direct access to advice tips, product information, promotional information
